note: Re-judged 2026-10-21. Origination: TestRFC3623GraceLSANeverOmitsAddressOnSharedMedia requires the type-3 TLV with the address for broadcast, NBMA and P2MP through grSharedMedia. Use: gr_helper.go graceRestarterV4 matches body.InterfaceAddr against FloodNeighbors on shared media, refuses a missing TLV or unknown address, and uses the Advertising Router elsewhere. TestRFC3623HelperIdentifiesRestarterByInterfaceAddress now loops broadcast, NBMA and P2MP: Grace-LSA from A naming B's address helps B, not A, exactly one session; on P2P it helps A. TestRFC3623HelperRefusesUnmatchedInterfaceAddress: unknown address or no TLV gives zero sessions on all three. TestRFC3623HelperFlushExitsNamedRestarter: a flush from A naming B's address ends B's session and keeps A's, on all three. Keying on the Advertising Router reddens every one; the earlier broadcast-only limitation is gone.
